news.why: Anthropic's provable-inference announcement is a company claim with stated limits; a claimed/evidence table fits and keeps attribution explicit. Strongest story, so it leads.

research.why: The 240-task collaboration benchmark is numbers-heavy; 4-6 bolded figures with citations. Label as preprint, not yet peer-reviewed.

invention.why: Weight-space programming has a claims/critics split and no independent replication; short questions let the honest caveat sit up front. Comparison and explainer avoided to prevent repeating recent combos.
